synthesis: The Scout 'Live Hits Pending Repossession' card omits the hotlist vehicle description because the card's data endpoint (recentHits) doesn't project vehicle_year/make/model + hotlist_us_state, while the map-pin endpoint (hits) does. Both endpoints read the same denormalized ClickHouse hit row and both already load every column via an unrestricted Eloquent ->get(); only the ->map() projection differs. MapShell.vue already renders those keys when present, so the fix is a pure additive projection change on the two recentHits() methods (driver + admin) — no Vue, no query, no schema change. Verified against current main (HEAD 0d332ac4): ticket is accurate, not stale.
